image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of two clusters of bright yellow coral fungi (likely Ramaria or Clavulinopsis species) growing on a forest floor covered in brown leaf litter, twigs, and patches of green moss. The foreground cluster is in sharp focus, showing intricate branching, while the background cluster is slightly out of focus.
